tasks.title: Persist WorkflowRun runtime state
tasks.description: Add the database migration, runtime types, repository, and service needed to create and read thin WorkflowRun records. The delivered capability is that a single service call can idempotently create an active run with Plan/Build/Check/Integrate StageRuns plus initial Plan tasks and checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Database initialization creates workflow run, stage run, task, and check tables with indexes for issue and run lookups
WorkflowRunService.startRun creates one active run bound to issue id and issue number with stable id, status, currentStage, and startedBy fields
The created run contains StageRuns for plan, build, check, and integrate in the correct order

The created Plan StageRun contains proposal, specs, design, tasks, and self-review tasks plus proposal-complete, specs-complete, design-complete, tasks-valid, self-review-passed, and user-approval checks
Calling startRun twice for the same non-terminal issue returns or preserves the same active run instead of creating a duplicate
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the service interface small and hide id generation, JSON serialization, default seed definitions, and stage ordering inside the service boundary.

tasks.title: Create WorkflowRun on issue start and expose it through API
tasks.description: Wire issue start handling so starting an issue creates or reuses the active WorkflowRun before workflow execution begins. Add an API endpoint that returns the active WorkflowRun for an issue with nested stages, tasks, checks, and approval snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting an issue through the existing start path creates an active WorkflowRun before runner execution
Starting an already-started or resumable issue reuses the existing active WorkflowRun instead of creating a duplicate
GET /api/issues/:number/workflow-run returns issueId, issueNumber, status, currentStage, and ordered StageRuns with tasks and checks
The API returns 404 or a clear empty-state response when an issue has no WorkflowRun yet, without falling back to logs or checkpoints
Existing start behavior for issue stage/status remains compatible with the current pipeline
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes WorkflowRunService.startRun and the nested read model from T-001.

tasks.title: Mirror stage runner progress into WorkflowRun
tasks.description: Pass the active WorkflowRun context through workflow execution and make stage lifecycle updates write to WorkflowRun first. Stage status, task status, check status, and approval snapshots should be updated in WorkflowRun without removing existing stage execution evidence or stage-state compatibility writes.
acceptanceCriteria: StageContext carries the active WorkflowRun or run id to BaseStageRunner and concrete runners
When a stage starts, passes, fails, or awaits approval, the matching StageRun and WorkflowRun currentStage/status are updated
Task results appended by BaseStageRunner are reflected as WorkflowRun task status updates
Check results persisted by BaseStageRunner are reflected as WorkflowRun check status updates
Approval requested by Plan or Check is stored as a StageRun approval snapshot while existing issue approval behavior still works
stage_executions and workflow_log continue to be written as evidence rather than becoming the current-state source
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep lifecycle/status mapping centralized in WorkflowRunService rather than scattering direct table updates.

tasks.title: Materialize Build tasks into WorkflowRun
tasks.description: Materialize Build StageRun tasks from the approved Plan `tasks.json` into the active WorkflowRun and update those task rows during Ralph execution. `tasks.json` can remain the executor input, but the WorkflowRun becomes the user-facing runtime task source.
acceptanceCriteria: After Plan produces and validates tasks.json, Build tasks are created under the existing WorkflowRun Build StageRun
Materialization upserts by task id and does not create duplicate Build task rows when repeated before Build starts
Ralph task completion, failure, skips, attempts, artifacts, and output update the corresponding WorkflowRun task rows
Build task materialization does not read from workflow_log, session logs, or checkpoint as the primary task source
Existing Ralph execution behavior and tasks.json updates continue to work
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The artifact boundary is tasks.json creation/validation; do not replace Ralph's execution input in this task.

tasks.title: Record runtime-added work as explained WorkflowRun tasks
tasks.description: Update repair, rebase, retry, and conflict-resolution paths so runtime-added work is appended to the current StageRun as ordinary WorkflowRun tasks. Each inserted task should keep reason and normalized causedBy metadata without introducing a user-visible task category.
acceptanceCriteria: Health-fix, review-repair, merge-repair, rebase, retry, and conflict-resolution work paths write WorkflowRun task rows when they create executable work
Runtime-added tasks appear in the same ordered task list as initial stage tasks
Each runtime-added task includes reason and causedBy metadata when the trigger is known
causedBy.type is normalized to check-failure, task-failure, branch-changed, conflict, retry, user-action, or system-policy
No API or UI response exposes planned/dynamic/static as a user-facing task category
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use WorkflowRunService APIs from earlier tasks; keep policy/decision records out of scope.

tasks.title: Project stage-state compatibility from WorkflowRun
tasks.description: Adapt the existing stage-state read path so clients that still call `/api/issues/:number/stage-state` receive a projection from WorkflowRun whenever an active run exists. This preserves the #181 page contract while making WorkflowRun the canonical read source.
acceptanceCriteria: /api/issues/:number/stage-state returns WorkflowRun-backed stages, tasks, checks, and approval data when a WorkflowRun exists
The compatibility response preserves one task list and one check list per stage
Plan initial tasks and checks are visible from WorkflowRun before runner-local task definitions execute
Build tasks and runtime-added repair/rebase/retry tasks appear in the compatibility task list from WorkflowRun state
Logs, session events, stage_executions, and checkpoints are not promoted to tasks or checks in the compatibility projection
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep legacy fallback only for issues without WorkflowRun data so existing data remains readable.

tasks.title: Use WorkflowRun-backed progress in Issue Detail UI
tasks.description: Update frontend API types, hooks, and Issue Detail data flow so the pipeline UI reads WorkflowRun-backed progress while preserving the existing visual model. `PipelineView` and `TaskProgressPanel` should continue to agree on the same task list and keep checks and approval visually separate.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend data loading prefers WorkflowRun-backed data for issue progress
PipelineView renders each StageRun with a task list and separate check list using WorkflowRun-backed data
TaskProgressPanel shows the same current-stage tasks as PipelineView for the same issue
Runtime-added tasks render in the normal task list with available explanation metadata
Checks and approval are not rendered as top-level task rows
Existing issue detail tests for stage-state consistency are updated or extended and pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/web/src/lib/api.ts, packages/cli/web/src/lib/types.ts, and Issue Detail components
tasks.notes: Prefer a thin frontend adapter so rendering components do not need to know whether data came from the native endpoint or compatibility projection.

tasks.title: Add WorkflowRun regression coverage
tasks.description: Add focused automated coverage for the new WorkflowRun behavior across persistence, start flow, runner updates, API projection, and UI consistency. These tests should prove WorkflowRun is the current-state source while evidence logs and checkpoints remain separate layers.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify start creates exactly one active WorkflowRun with stable issue binding and seeded Plan data
Tests verify the workflow-run API returns ordered StageRuns with tasks, checks, and approval snapshots
Tests verify Build tasks materialize from tasks.json into the same WorkflowRun
Tests verify runtime-added repair/rebase/retry/conflict tasks include reason and causedBy metadata
Tests verify stage_executions, workflow_log, session logs, and checkpoints are not used as primary task/check state
Tests verify Issue Detail surfaces render WorkflowRun-backed task/check data consistently
All relevant tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task intentionally depends on the implementation tasks so it can add end-to-end regression coverage over the final behavior rather than only isolated mocks.
